title: Modern statutory settlement
documented_fact: The National Heritage Act 1983 establishes the statutory Board/functions underpinning the modern V&A.
why_it_matters: This is the appropriate baseline for modern legal purpose and governance.
limit_or_continuity: Earlier nineteenth-century purpose requires separate founding/departmental urtexts and is not inferred from today's museum history pages.

title: Current sponsor framework
documented_fact: The DCMS framework sets out contemporary sponsorship, public appointments, financial controls and accountability.
why_it_matters: It shows how a statutory museum is inserted into modern Whitehall machinery.
limit_or_continuity: The 1983 Act remains upstream of the framework.
